issue: Author is matched with case-sensitive instr(author, ?) instead of LIKE ? ESCAPE on both columns, so AC2/AC3 fail for authors.
evidence: q=fowler does not match author 'Martin Fowler'; q=FOWLER vs q=Fowler return different lists.

issue: Underscore is not escaped, so it acts as a LIKE wildcard on title (AC8).
evidence: Only \ and % are replaced; q=_ becomes pattern %_% and matches every title instead of returning [].

issue: Off-by-one in length check: exactly 100 chars after trim is rejected, but AC6 requires 200 for 100 and 400 only for 101+.
No single-string validation: repeated or non-string q is coerced by String() instead of returning 400 { error: 'Query must be a single string' }.
